title: Murašû archive, Nippur / Архив дома Мурашу
author: Scribes of the Murašû firm
edition: Hilprecht & Clay BE 9 (1898), Clay BE 10 (1904), PBS 2/1 (1912), all public domain on archive.org; Cardascia 1951; Stolper 1985.
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia has no article (red link 'Мурашу[англ.]' in several articles); no Russian translation found.
en_evidence: Clay's volumes translate selected texts; Stolper 1985 edits a subset (en.wikipedia 'Murashu family').
value: Achaemenid land-for-service system and Persian nobles known from Ctesias (Menostanes, Artoxares, Arbarius). Economic history of Persia during the Peloponnesian War.
ai_feasibility: high: formulaic contracts with public-domain copies and transliterations; prosopography needs checking.
pilot_unit: Texts naming Ctesian nobles, or BE 10 (Darius II); c. 100 texts
